title: Psychology Facts
hook: One sentence that makes you do what you planned.
facts: The *cue* does the remembering for you.
Not 'I'll study', but: *If it's 7 p.m., I open my book.*
In 2006, Gollwitzer and Sheeran reviewed *94 studies*.
Plans with a trigger beat *good intentions*.
outro: Name the trigger. Then do the thing.
